title: Activate your event access
explanation: Activate this one-time code on the device you will use at the event. It is not used until you select Activate access.
qr-explanation: Have the participant scan this code on the device they will use at the event.
qr-expired: This code has expired. Ask an organiser for a new one.
unavailable: Access is temporarily unavailable. Please ask an organiser for a new code.
